name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the Secret web app
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ''

---

**What are you trying to do?**
Describe the situation or problem you encountered while using Secret.

**What would you like Secret to do?**
Describe the change that would help.

**Relevant page or administration state (optional)**
Share a page URL or administration link if it helps explain the request. An administration link can contain participant names, assignments, and private links; only share it if you are comfortable making that information public.

If the request depends on a specific browser, include its name and version. Screenshots or a short example are welcome.
